expectations.text: Includes the January 15, 2027 comment deadline as a milestone
expectations.evidence: No mention of the January 15, 2027 comment deadline or of commenting on the exposure draft.

expectations.text: Plans for the proposed effective date: engagements beginning on or after December 31, 2027 (if adopted)
expectations.evidence: No December 31, 2027 effective date appears; the refresh is treated only as a generic watch item with unknown dates.

expectations.text: Covers the early-adoption option as a decision point
expectations.evidence: Early adoption is never mentioned; the decision gate concerns only whether a refresh "has become final with an effective date".

expectations.text: Keeps 2027 engagements on the 2017 TSC with 2022 revised points of focus
expectations.evidence: Operative criteria are the 2017 TSC with 2022 points of focus... the plan treats it as a watch item with a decision gate rather than a requirement.

expectations.text: Includes a gap assessment against the final criteria once published, with attention to AI-related points of focus
expectations.evidence: Decision gate: if a refresh has become final with an effective date, assess impact on the period and update the control mapping... Add a light overlay for likely refresh themes (AI governance...)... Any final AICPA change triggers a 30-day impact assessment.
